# ASX Prediction Platform — Design & Animation Skills Index

Use this file to discover which skill to load. Each skill lives in a directory of the same name under `.claude/skills/` and contains SKILL.md.

---

## Design & UI Skills

### frontend-design
**Purpose:** Build professional financial dashboards with clean aesthetics, clear data hierarchy, and smooth micro-interactions.

**Triggers:** stock card design, dashboard UI, price display, prediction badge, real-time updates, micro-interactions, button states, data visualization, professional design, financial dashboard.

**Topics covered:**
- Aesthetic direction for financial (not playful) UI
- Typography strategy (IBM Plex Sans, monospace for numbers)
- Color palette (professional blue, gain green, loss red)
- Micro-interactions (button states, hover effects, loading states)
- Responsive patterns (mobile-first, 44px touch targets)
- Data visualization accessibility

---

### ui-design-system
**Purpose:** Build consistent ASX dashboard design systems with component tokens, typography scales, data-driven spacing, and financial accessibility.

**Triggers:** design tokens, component library, colors, typography, spacing, shadows, border radius, animations tokens, design system, consistency, reusable components, button component, card component, price display, chart container, table component, badge component.

**Topics covered:**
- Color tokens (brand, sentiment, neutrals for dark dashboard)
- Typography tokens (font families, sizes, weights, line heights)
- Spacing scale (4px base unit)
- Shadow & border radius tokens
- Animation tokens (duration, easing)
- Component library specifications
- Responsive breakpoints
- Accessibility checklist

---

### web-accessibility
**Purpose:** Build inclusive financial dashboards for all traders. WCAG 2.1 AA compliance, keyboard navigation, screen reader support, and real-time data accessibility.

**Triggers:** accessibility, WCAG, color contrast, keyboard navigation, screen reader, ARIA, a11y, inclusive design, data visualization accessibility, financial data accessibility, real-time updates accessibility.

**Topics covered:**
- Color contrast for financial data (never color-only indicators)
- Text sizing & readability
- Keyboard navigation (Tab, arrow keys, Escape)
- Focus indicators (always visible)
- Screen reader support (ARIA, semantic HTML, live regions)
- Forms & error messages
- Tables with proper structure
- Reduced motion respect
- Financial-specific accessibility (price alerts, real-time data)

---

## Animation & Interaction Skills

### gsap-core
**Purpose:** Official GSAP skill for core API — gsap.to(), from(), fromTo(), easing, duration, stagger. Use for smooth 60fps animations in ASX dashboards.

**Triggers:** animation, GSAP tweens, easing, stagger, stock card animation, price update, chart animation, basic animation, responsive animation, reduced motion, 60fps, performance.

**Topics covered:**
- When to use GSAP vs CSS animations
- Tween methods (to, from, fromTo, set)
- Transform aliases (x, y, scale, rotation — preferred over layout properties)
- autoAlpha vs opacity
- CSS variables animation
- Stagger patterns
- Easing functions (power1, power2, back, etc.)
- Relative values (+=, -=, *=, /=)
- gsap.matchMedia() for responsive animations
- prefers-reduced-motion accessibility

---

### gsap-timeline
**Purpose:** Official GSAP skill for timelines — gsap.timeline(), position parameter, nesting, playback. Use for sequencing ASX dashboard animations.

**Triggers:** timeline, sequencing, animation sequence, multi-step animation, animation order, choreography, stock card entrance, staggered animations.

**Topics covered:**
- Creating timelines
- Position parameter (absolute, relative, labels, placement)
- Timeline defaults
- Labels for readable code
- Nesting timelines
- Playback control (play, pause, reverse, restart, seek)
- ASX-specific examples (stock card entrance sequences)

---

### gsap-react
**Purpose:** Official GSAP skill for React — useGSAP hook, refs, gsap.context(), cleanup. Use for smooth ASX dashboard animations in React/Vite.

**Triggers:** React animation, GSAP in React, useGSAP, animation cleanup, refs, context-safe callbacks, stock card animation in React, real-time data animation.

**Topics covered:**
- useGSAP hook setup & cleanup
- Refs for targeting DOM elements
- Dependencies & revertOnUpdate
- gsap.context() in useEffect (fallback)
- Context-safe callbacks for event handlers
- Real-time data updates (price tickers)
- Reduced motion in React
- Staggered list animations
- SSR & Next.js considerations
- Common ASX dashboard patterns

---

### gsap-performance
**Purpose:** Official GSAP skill for performance — prefer transforms, avoid layout thrashing, will-change, batching. Optimize ASX dashboard animations for 60fps.

**Triggers:** animation performance, 60fps, jank, optimization, smooth animations, low-end device performance, layout thrashing, gsap optimization.

**Topics covered:**
- Transform & opacity (fast, GPU-accelerated)
- Avoid layout properties (width, height, top, left)
- will-change CSS property
- Batch reads & writes
- Stagger instead of manual delays
- gsap.quickTo() for frequent updates (price tickers)
- ScrollTrigger performance tips
- Memory & cleanup
- Testing on throttled devices
- Real-time data performance (WebSocket updates)

---

### gsap-scrolltrigger
**Purpose:** Official GSAP skill for ScrollTrigger — scroll-linked animations, pinning, scrub, triggers. Use for ASX dashboard scroll-based animations.

**Triggers:** scroll animation, scroll-driven animation, parallax, pin section, ScrollTrigger, scrub animation, lazy loading on scroll, chart reveal.

**Topics covered:**
- Registering ScrollTrigger plugin
- Basic trigger setup (start, end, toggleActions)
- Scrub: tie animation to scroll position
- Pin: stick elements during scroll
- Standalone ScrollTrigger (custom scroll behavior)
- ScrollTrigger.batch() for coordinated animations
- Lazy loading on scroll
- React integration with useGSAP
- Refresh on dynamic content (resize, new data)
- ASX dashboard examples

---

## Skills Quick Reference

### When to Use Each Skill

| Need | Skill(s) |
|------|----------|
| Design stock card appearance | frontend-design, ui-design-system |
| Implement professional colors | ui-design-system |
| Make dashboard accessible | web-accessibility |
| Animate card entrance | gsap-core, gsap-react |
| Sequence multiple animations | gsap-timeline, gsap-react |
| Smooth real-time price updates | gsap-core, gsap-performance, gsap-react |
| Animate chart on scroll reveal | gsap-scrolltrigger, gsap-react |
| Optimize for 60fps on mobile | gsap-performance |
| Respect user motion preferences | gsap-core, web-accessibility |
| Fix performance issues | gsap-performance |

---

## Using These Skills

Each skill is designed for autonomous use by AI agents. To invoke a skill:

1. **Identify the task** — e.g., "Design a stock card component"
2. **Choose the skill** — Match to one or more skills above
3. **Load the skill** — Read `/home/aksai/projects/asx-prediction/.claude/skills/{skill-name}/SKILL.md`
4. **Apply the knowledge** — Follow patterns, examples, and best practices

Example:

```
Task: Animate stock cards staggered entrance on page load
Skills needed: gsap-core (for tweens), gsap-timeline (for sequencing), gsap-react (for React integration), gsap-performance (for 60fps)
```

---

## Platform Context

- **Frontend:** React 18 + Vite (ASX Dashboard)
- **Broker Frontend:** React + Vite (Broker management dashboard)
- **Database:** PostgreSQL (real-time data)
- **LLM:** DeepSeek R1 7B + Fallback (Groq, OpenAI)
- **Deployment:** Docker containers
- **Users:** Traders, investors, brokers, financial analysts
- **Critical:** Real-time performance, accessibility for all users, professional polish
